T: It's Christmas. Even the TV boss gets dinner.
D: A ruthless TV executive is visited by three ghosts on Christmas Eve.
P: Serve the mains when the Ghost shows Frank his brother's Christmas dinner.
S: Blinis with crème fraîche and salmon, garlic toast with tomato and basil
Blinis with crème fraîche and smoked salmon, and mini bruschetta with tomato, basil and garlic, laid out on silver trays.
Cab snacks. Earl gave young Frank 5lb of veal.

Pretzels, nuts and rice cereal squares roasted in butter, Worcestershire, garlic and smoked paprika until crunchy, served by the paper bag. Melt 80g butter with 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Toss with 200g pretzels, 200g mixed nuts and 100g rice cereal squares. Spread on 2 lined trays and bake at 130C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Cool completely so it crisps, then fill small paper bags.
Eggs and buttered toast strips, with a toaster-swinging fairy
Thick white bread toasted golden, buttered, cut into soldiers, served with soft-boiled eggs cooked 6 minutes.
M: James's table. Frank declines every year.

Brined roast turkey breast, sage and onion stuffing, crispy roast potatoes, glazed carrots, cranberry sauce and a rich gravy for a warm family table. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2L water with 60g salt and 30g sugar. Rub with 40g butter and roast at 170C for 75 minutes to 70C, then rest. Bake 150g breadcrumbs with 1 sautéed onion, sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock for 30 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in oil at 220C for 45 minutes and 500g carrots with honey. Make gravy with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
Beef chuck, carrots and potatoes braised for 3 hours, with crusty bread
Beef chuck browned in batches, onion, carrot and potato softened, stock and thyme added, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours until the meat falls apart. Crusty bread to mop it up.
W: Steamed fruit pudding soaked in brandy, flamed at the table, with custard
Fruit soaked overnight in brandy, mixed with butter, brown sugar, eggs, breadcrumbs and spice, steamed 4 hours, flamed with brandy. Custard.
K: Cooked custard eggnog with brandy and fresh nutmeg, served chilled
Yolks whisked with sugar, hot milk and cream poured in, stirred over low heat to 75C, chilled, finished with brandy and fresh nutmeg.

s.note: Blinis with crème fraîche and salmon, garlic toast with tomato and basil
s.how: Top 12 blinis with crème fraîche and 100g smoked salmon. Toast 12 baguette slices, rub with garlic and top with 2 diced tomatoes and basil. Arrange both on silver trays.

s.note: Eggs and buttered toast strips, with a toaster-swinging fairy
s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes. Toast 4 thick slices white bread golden, butter and cut into soldiers. Put each egg in a cup, take the top off and dip away.

m.note: Beef chuck, carrots and potatoes braised for 3 hours, with crusty bread
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 carrots, add 600g potatoes, 750ml stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until the meat falls apart. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Steamed fruit pudding soaked in brandy, flamed at the table, with custard
w.how: Soak 500g dried fruit in 100ml brandy overnight. Mix with 125g butter, 125g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 100g breadcrumbs, 75g flour and 2 tsp mixed spice. Steam 4 hours. Warm 2 tbsp brandy, light it and pour over at the table. Serve with custard.

d.note: Cooked custard eggnog with brandy and fresh nutmeg, served chilled
d.how: Whisk 4 yolks with 80g sugar. Pour over 500ml hot milk and 200ml cream, then stir over low heat to 75C. Chill well, stir in 100ml brandy and grate fresh nutmeg on top.
